summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K to incorporate an underwriting agreement into its existing Form F-3 shelf registration, covering a $700 million issuance of 5.750% notes due 2036. The notes were priced September 9, 2026, under a base indenture dated October 14, 2020, as supplemented September 11, 2026, with The Bank of New York Mellon, London Branch as trustee. BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, Mizuho Securities USA and SMBC Nikko Securities America serve as representatives of the underwriters. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation; watch for pricing spread, coupon demand and any proceeds earmarked for acquisitions or refinancing.
